summary.text: Amelia Hamer is the Liberal candidate for Malvern, where Michael O'Brien is retiring at the 2026 Victorian election. She works as an equities analyst, has worked in banking and finance in Britain and Melbourne, and was an adviser to Senator Jane Hume. She stood for the Liberals in Kooyong at the 2025 federal election and lost to independent Monique Ryan. Wikipedia describes her as a grand-niece of former Liberal premier Rupert Hamer.

summary.text: Christina Zigouras is running as a community independent in Malvern, which its Liberal MP is leaving at the 2026 Victorian election. A building designer who set up her own design practice, she has also taught at Holmesglen and Box Hill Institute and worked in her family's manufacturing firm. She has run for parties before: for Labor in Sandringham in 2014, and second on the Greens' Northern Metropolitan upper-house ticket in 2018.

summary.text: David Segal is the Libertarian candidate for Malvern at the 2026 Victorian election. A retired stockbroker, he says he has spent his whole life in the Stonnington area and has stood for the party, formerly the Liberal Democrats, at four earlier state and federal elections. His statement for the party targets renewable energy policy, government intervention in the energy market, crime and living costs.

summary.text: Edward Bode is One Nation's candidate for Malvern at the 2026 Victorian election. According to the ABC, he came to Australia from Canada as a baby, grew up in Mount Waverley, studied chemical engineering and commerce, and has spent more than two decades in banking. One Nation's candidate page refused automated access, so it could not be checked.

summary.text: Gavin Leonard is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Malvern at the 2026 Victorian election. A renter and father of three who lives in Malvern East, he works in audiovisual and technical support, funeral services and transport. He has been a delegate for the Australian Workers' Union and the Renters and Housing Union, and has helped run volunteer festivals and community spaces.

summary.text: Georgia Katsikis is standing for the Greens in Malvern at the 2026 Victorian election. She is a researcher and advocate for people with disability, previously worked as a psychologist, and is a member of a City of Melbourne advisory committee on disability.
